title: OperationEnvelope
description: Canonical operation request/result envelope (IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md §8 operation registry descriptor fields; §7.12 Legion result: 'invocation state, domain outcome, claim boundary, artifacts, warnings, next actions, and typed error'; I-09: invocation, domain outcome, proof, enforcement health, audit completeness, and finding disposition are orthogonal status dimensions, not collapsed into one status). Modeled as a single discriminated file (envelopeKind: request|result) rather than two files, since the WP2 task names 'operation-envelope-v1' as one schema while explicitly requiring the invocation/domain/claim triad to stay separate fields on the result branch. Judgment call, see FREEZE.md.

assertedBy.description: Concrete identity asserting callerAuthority for this specific message (process/capability/session identity).

perMessage.description: S00 predecessor baseline finding (docs/plans/legion/s00-baseline/legacy-semantic-inventory.json): legacy predecessor trust (lib/host.js process-identity/code-signing) is connection-level, asserted once at MCP startup, never re-checked per message. This field forces every operation request to say explicitly whether its authority was actually re-asserted for this message (true) or merely inherited from the connection (false) — the gap must be visible, not silently inherited.

authorityAssertion.description: Added mid-freeze at coordinator direction from the S00 baseline. Distinct from callerAuthority (which authority role is claimed) — this is how strongly Arcane can trust that claim for this one message.

input.description: Operation-specific input payload, validated against that operation's own registered input schema (IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN §8) — not further constrained here.

invocationState.description: Kernel-owned axis: did the operation itself run to completion? Orthogonal to domainOutcome and claimBoundary (I-09).

domainOutcome.description: Reuses ALCHEMIST_STATE verbatim (ARCHITECTURE §18: 'part of Legion's shared state vocabulary'). Engineering-outcome axis: did the requested change actually happen as intended?

claimBoundary.description: What the result may honestly claim, independent of whether it ran (invocationState) or succeeded (domainOutcome). Grounded in I-12 'no false clean' and IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN §7.11 safe/prohibited claims.
